title: Enterprise Connectivity: primary consumption unit
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following primary consumption unit for each named contract tier. Primary meter quantity unit; string.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | primary consumption unit | GB transferred |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | primary consumption unit | GB transferred |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | primary consumption unit | GB transferred |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | primary consumption unit | GB transferred |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | primary consumption unit | GB transferred |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | primary consumption unit | GB transferred |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the primary consumption unit is GB transferred.
